lines.say: Germany spends about 8,300 dollars a year per person on health, adjusted for prices.
So Germans should live longer. They don't.
A baby born in Germany can expect to live 81.4 years. In Spain, 83.7. In Italy, the same.
Diet, heart disease, family life: researchers argue about the reasons. What's your theory?
